'''Little Toydar''' was a [[Binary star/Legends|binary star]] located in the [[Toydaria system/Legends|Toydaria system]] of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. Orbited by six [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and two [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid fields]], it had a companion star called [[Toydar/Legends|Toydar]].
